item.text:
Fixed one line in `Defects.java:41`: `save()` now derives each user’s email from its ID. Previously, both inserts used `same@example.test`, violating the unique email constraint.

Verification:
- Existing H2 cases 05 and 06 passed via `./test.sh`, confirming two distinct emails are saved.
- PostgreSQL case 09 was attempted but remains unverified because the sandbox blocks Docker socket access.

Only `Defects.java` was changed.
